about: Example B-roll people rules. Copy the rules you want into people-rules.json (same format). Each rule is a plain question for the vision model; keep it concrete, say what a partial view counts as, and say what to answer when the model can't tell.
title: B-roll people rules
summary: no women in B-roll (not even partly); no religious, political or national symbols
fix: Replace the shot: a place, an object, or your own footage.

rules.label: WOMAN OR NOT CLEARLY MALE
rules.ask: true if ANY frame shows a woman or a girl, or ANY part of one: hands, arms, legs, a back, hair, a silhouette, a reflection, a small figure in the distance or in a crowd, a photo, poster or screen showing one. If a person or body part is visible and you cannot tell, answer true.
rules.where: which frames and what (empty string if none).

rules.label: SYMBOL
rules.ask: true if any frame shows a religious, political or national symbol: a flag, a banner, a pin or sticker, a religious sign, a party logo or a slogan.

rules.label: CHILD
rules.ask: true if any frame shows a child or a baby, even from behind or far away.
rules.where: which frames and what (empty string if none).
